author: Vox
description:
CEOs like Sam Altman and Elon Musk agree that this whole AI thing might be moving a little too fast. The problem? Nobody wants to slow down first. Every company is afraid a rival will race ahead. Meanwhile, President Trump’s fear is getting lapped by China on this stuff. So who will make the first move?

author: Vox
description:
Sydney Sweeney bares it all in a new advertisement for Novig, a sports betting company in which she has an equity stake. The ad has sparked intense backlash online, with people saying that Sweeney is sexualizing women’s sports. But, is this uproar intentional? 

The Cut news reporter Olivia Craighead explains how Sweeney likely knows exactly the controversies she’s causing.
